profiles.description: General mimicry-system discovery across the Tree of Life. Query changes require a version bump (SOP Phase 27) so systematic-review provenance stays answerable.
profiles.notes: v1.0.0 initial profile. Known gaps to revisit: myrmecomorphy, myrmecomorphic, Pouyannian, deceptive pollination, aggressive mimicry by common name (planned v1.1.0).

profiles.description: Ant-mimicry focused sweep (myrmecophily/myrmecomorphy): spiders, Hemiptera and other arthropods imitating Formicidae.

Same discovery intent as PROFILE:MIMICRY_GENERAL, through the OpenAlex API. Cross-source coverage matters: OpenAlex indexes preprints and venues Crossref misses, and its abstracts are openly available.
